svg.text: Ubame county, Moriguchi province - seat of County Magistrate Bayushi no Daika Koharu

text.data-names: compound-shrine-1 compound-shrine-2 compound-shrine-3 compound-shrine-4 compound-shrine-5 compound-shrine-6 compound-shrine-7

g.text: The east wall IS the Fox/Scorpion line, and it cuts the
parley-room floor: the Kitsune are met, and the charcoal
tallies agreed, without either side leaving its own soil.
